description: This PHP source file defines an OpenCart admin controller class for managing user permissions, including listing, editing, and deleting user groups and their associated permissions.

classes.name: UserPermission
classes.description: A controller class for managing user permission groups in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the main user permission management page with permissions list, header, footer, and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to display the list of user groups, calls getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches user group data, handles pagination, and renders the user group list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a user group, preparing permissions and existing data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the save request for creating or updating a user group, validates permissions and input.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected user groups after permission checks.
